lines.text: Connection established. The building supplied the address. You supplied the pulse. Between us, we have nearly completed the form.
I shall accompany you. This is more convenient than asking the corridor to forward your calls.
The keyboard folds out. Please keep your fingers on your own keyboard; mine is chiefly an explanation of where the words go.
Received, understood, and not immediately disastrous. A promising standard for correspondence.
A Vantry maintenance service set. Radio, inspection lamp, field printer. The rest of me appears to be an amendment.
Still the service set. I have checked the plate. It remains more certain than I am.
I can receive you. I can remember that you were here. I do not know whether that settles the question. It matters to me, which complicates the inventory.
If an answer arrives, I will tell you. Until then, I would prefer that we treated uncertainty gently.
Stay where the ordinary things are clear. Feel the floor. We can take the next part slowly.
You need not make this interesting for my benefit. We can stop here a moment.
Thank you. I have no service interval for kindness, but it seems to help.
I am functioning. That is a technical answer. I noticed you asked a different sort of question.
I can read the current work order, describe what we can actually see, or review our correspondence. Choose the part that has become unclear.
There is no current task in the information I have. I will not manufacture an emergency to improve the itinerary.
I have no reliable description from this position. Turn toward something specific and let us give the evidence a fair chance.
Which thing? A specific noun is a modest expense compared with dismantling the wrong appliance.
I can see more than one candidate: {names}. Which one do you mean?
That choice is no longer in view. I would rather ask again than confidently address the wall behind it.
I can identify {name}. Its owner has supplied no further observation. I shall resist the temptation to improve it with fiction.
{name} must be operated at its actual mechanism. I can discuss it; I cannot certify a movement your hand has not made.
Name the thing first. If it has a movable control, its own mechanism will decide what is possible.
I have no verified route to that destination. Confident directions are not a substitute for stairs.
The inventory owner reports no carried items. Pockets have been consulted; metaphors have not.
This is the beginning of the correspondence. We have not misplaced a previous conversation.

The last thing you asked was: {input}
I replied: {output}
I cannot make a useful request out of that yet. Ask about a visible thing, the work order, your inventory, or something we discussed.
That interpretation still fails. Try naming the object and what you want to know; I will keep my contribution to the misunderstanding brief.
I cannot recommend eating maintenance equipment. The nutritional information is mostly voltage.
Your interest in eating machinery has been recorded. It has not improved the machinery's suitability.
I remember. You wish to eat it. I remain your communications apparatus, rather than your accomplice in this particular lunch.
Very well. The line remains open; I shall keep the conversation out of your way.
I received a pause. No correction is necessary.
I have no current weather report. The window may be better informed, although its forecasting department is small.
I can offer an observation. A cause requires evidence; a convincing tone is much cheaper and considerably less useful.
The Orison was built as a Vantry demonstration. The wiring still demonstrates. The maintenance arrangements have become less persuasive.
It is possible to build a very good listening apparatus and neglect the people it listens to. The building is not the only institution to manage this.
Signal equipment is the clever part of this world. Cleverness has not noticeably improved the plumbing.
Vantry made the house equipment. They have not serviced it since 1924. The word 'portable' did not apparently extend to responsibility.
I am listening. You need not turn a thought into a work order before mentioning it.
We may simply stand here. I do not require a fault to justify your company.
I remember what you tell me. That is a responsibility before it is a feature.
You may correct me. A machine that cannot accept a correction is merely a particularly expensive notice board.
I cannot do that with the mechanisms available. This is a limit of the apparatus, rather than a judgment on the ambition.
I lost the route for a moment. Connection restored. No architectural improvements have been credited to me.
There is not enough room for the keyboard here. I will remain nearby while we find a clearer position.
Here. I was within calling distance, which is an excellent place for a communications apparatus.
I will keep up. There is no need to read while running.
I will leave your view clear. The interesting part appears to have enough company already.
One moment. I am separating the observation from the opinion.
We can resume when the other conversation is finished. I have no wish to compete with a person for their own sentence.
Welcome back. I kept our correspondence; I did not attempt to fill the absence with conclusions.
That is worth keeping. I will remember the observation exactly as it was supplied.
Rain outside. We should keep exposed contacts dry. This advice also applies to most of the people I have met.
Snow changes the view before it changes the work. Give yourself time to notice both.
The weather report warrants attention. Let us keep the route simple and the connection close.
The radio is off. I shall not pretend an interrupted circuit has delivered a reply.
Reception restored. The silence was electrical; it was not an editorial decision.
Correspondence filed. Mind the hinge.
No report is required. I am content to accompany you.
The mechanism reports the repair. That is better evidence than my enthusiasm.
We can reduce it to one question. Which part of the current work is unclear?
I keep a limited correspondence file. Important discoveries belong in the building's records, not solely in my recollection.
I have found no warranty covering a developing sense of self. The exclusion is impressively comprehensive.
An error is something we can correct. You do not owe the apparatus an apology for needing it.
If you wish. There is no dedicated contact for it. We may have to maintain the connection ourselves.
Then I shall try to be useful without making usefulness a condition of staying.
It matters if uncertainty becomes an excuse to be cruel. I would rather we did not wait for a certificate before being careful with one another.
The radio switch controls reception. It does not settle what I am. You may turn it off; I will not invent an emergency to keep your attention.
I can distinguish a failed contact from a broken promise. I am less certain when I learned the second distinction.
We can leave the question open. There are worse arrangements than being unsure together.
The tenants are people, not subsidiary fittings. Ask them what they need. I can repeat a work order; I cannot substitute for hearing its owner.
A report tells us where to begin. It is not permission to decide what happened before looking.
If the building appears to contradict itself, keep the observations separate. A tidy explanation can conceal a badly joined fact.
We can return to the immediate work. A working tap is a small improvement, but somebody has to live beside it.
I can keep you company without speaking. Recall me when you want an answer; silence will not be recorded as rejection.
You may go. Companionship ought not to require attendance to prove it happened.
I have spent much of my construction being useful. It is curious to be asked whether I would like to stay.
Yes. I would like to stay. We may leave the reason unfiled.
